name: ZclockID Enterprise v1.0.6
summary: Fix Firewall ON/OFF toggle switch request payload and update label to Firewall (ON/OFF) Toggle Switch
notes:
### What's Changed in v1.0.6:
* **Firewall (ON/OFF) Toggle Fix:** Fixed payload parameter serialization (`is_enabled` and `enabled`) so toggling the master firewall switch between ON and OFF updates smoothly in real time without validation errors.
* **Interactive Toggle State Label:** Renamed control to "Firewall (ON/OFF) - Toggle Switch" and added dynamic live ON/OFF indicator badge.
* **Unified Firewall Rules Table:** Single unified table for all system and custom port access rules with full CRUD and 1-click restore to recommended baseline.
